And if you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to contact me.

​Prices usually range from $100- $150 a day, depending on type of retreat chosen.
Included in the all bookings:
  • Accommodation in the jungle (lodge) 
  • All meals (breakfast, lunch and dinner) while in the jungle
  • activities dependent on retreat booked
  • Transportation from Iquitos to lodge and back (car/minibus and boat)
  • Mineral water
  • Rubber boots​

​If you are bringing a group of 5 or more! Your part of retreat is free. We encourage all to bring their family and friends and enjoy this jungle paradise.

How to Pay:
A nonrefundable deposit of 25% is required at time of booking in order to reserve time you are requesting.
Payment in full should be made at least 2 weeks prior to arrival.
